sources: Wikimedia Commons individual file pages and primary manufacturer catalogs linked in README.md
constraints: Initial public API searches were rate limited (HTTP 429); subsequent research used cached evidence, article metadata and slower title searches.
Searches returning unrelated non-automotive subjects were rejected.
No paid photographs were purchased, no manufacturer photos copied without permission, and no AI photographs substituted.
No claim that no usable photograph exists outside the reviewed sources.
